Zoe (PM): Quick triage: sales wants faster audit-search, guaranteed forensic export window, and a safe BYOK offboarding flow. How do we sequence?
Kai (Eng): Short: audit-search SLA is index/infra work (2 sprints). Forensic export window needs job orchestration + rate limits (2-3 sprints). BYOK offboarding (key revocation + re-encryption policy) is risky, likely 4 sprints.
Renee (Security): Offboarding policy must avoid leaving data inaccessible. Need key escrow option or customer-signed acceptance. Also require tamper-evidence on exports.
Tariq (Legal): Forensic export SLA must include proof of export (signed manifest) and a creds-handshake for requesting exports. Offboarding needs contractual acceptance and data-access audit trail.
Zoe (PM): Proposal: 1) Implement signed-export manifests + 72h export SLA for pilot, 2) Audit-search performance improvements, 3) BYOK offboarding spec with escrow as opt-in.
Kai (Eng): We can ship manifest + export pipeline in 3 sprints. Audit-search perf can land in parallel in 2 sprints. BYOK offboarding design doc by EOW.
Renee (Security): Add requirement: exports include SHA256 manifest + operator signature, stored immutably. Add anomaly detection for bulk exports.
ops-bot: export-concurrency limit set to 8 per-tenant for pilot; alert if queue > 40.
Tariq (Legal): I'll draft the export SLA clause and offboarding consent language.
Zoe (PM): Action items: Kai PRD for export+manifest by Tue, Renee security checklist, Tariq SLA draft by Fri. Re-evaluate next Wed.
Kai (Eng): noted
Renee (Security): noted
Tariq (Legal): noted
